title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 8:5-13
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 8:5-13</bp-cite>. Greek text: SBL Greek New Testament, © 2010 Society of Biblical Literature and Logos Bible Software (CC BY 4.0). Translation and literary design in progress.
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="5" /> Now when he <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="tan">entered into Kapharnaoum</char>,
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        a centurion
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="turquoise" word-lang="greek" word-original="προσῆλθεν">approached</char> him,
      </group>
      <group>
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="violet">pleading with</char> him <verse number="6" /> and saying,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        “<char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">Master</char>, my <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue" word-lang="greek" word-original="παῖς" word-gloss="son / servant">boy</char> <char style="bd" mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">has been thrown down</char><note style="x" caller="+" xref="matthew-8-6-thrown"><char style="xt">Matthew 9:2</char></note> in the house,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        paralyzed, terribly tormented.”
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="7" /> And he said to him,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        “I, <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan" word-lang="greek" word-original="ἐλθὼν">coming</char>, will heal him?”
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="8" /> And responding, the centurion said,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        “<char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">Master</char>, <char style="bd">I am not worthy</char><note style="x" caller="+" xref="matthew-8-8-worthy"><char style="xt">Matthew 3:11</char></note> that you <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">come in</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange" word-lang="greek" word-original="ὑπὸ">under</char> my roof,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        but only speak with a word,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        and my <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue" word-lang="greek" word-original="παῖς" word-gloss="son / servant">boy</char> <char style="bd" mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green" word-lang="greek" word-original="ἰαθήσεται">will be healed</char><note style="x" caller="+" xref="matthew-8-8-healed"><char style="xt">Matthew 15:28</char></note>.
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="9" /> For I too am a man <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange" word-lang="greek" word-original="ὑπὸ">under</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="orange">authority</char>,
      </group>
      <group>
        having soldiers <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange" word-lang="greek" word-original="ὑπʼ">under</char> me,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        and I say to this one, ‘<char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">Go</char>!’ and he <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">goes</char>,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        and to another, ‘<char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan" word-lang="greek" word-original="Ἔρχου">Come</char>!’ and he <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan" word-lang="greek" word-original="ἔρχεται">comes</char>,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        and to my slave, ‘<char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">Do this</char>!’ and he <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">does</char>.”
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="10" /> ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐθαύμασεν
      </group>
      <group>
        καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">ἀκολουθοῦσιν</char>·
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        παρʼ οὐδενὶ τοσαύτην πίστιν ἐν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ εὗρον.
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="1">
        <verse number="11" /> λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        πολλοὶ ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν καὶ δυσμῶν ἥξουσιν
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        καὶ ἀνακλιθήσονται μετὰ Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακὼβ ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν·
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        <verse number="12" /> οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ τῆς βασιλείας <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">ἐκβληθήσονται</char> εἰς τὸ σκότος τὸ ἐξώτερον·
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων.
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="13" /> καὶ εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῷ ἑκατοντάρχῃ·
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">Ὕπαγε</char>,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        ὡς ἐπίστευσας γενηθήτω σοι·
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        καὶ <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">ἰάθη</char> ὁ <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">παῖς</char> ἐν τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐκείνῃ.
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
